text:
devon: heads-up — CI shard bazel-linux-shard-12 is red after merge of #4123 (alex). Looks like a compile error in cc/config.
ci-bot: [CI] shard bazel-linux-shard-12 failed for commit 9f3b2a7 - http://ci.internal/9f3b2a7 - Failed target: //tools/cc:config
alex: ugh, that PR bumped absl/flags version and tweaked include paths. didn't hit locally. sending a quick patch.
jamal: can you paste the failing compiler output?
devon: here's the top of the error:
```
../third_party/absl/flags/flag.cc:27:10: fatal error: 'absl/strings/string_view.h' file not found
 #include "absl/strings/string_view.h"
          ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
1 error generated.
```
alex: hmm looks like the include search path dropped the absl include root. possibly a cc_library visibility or new default -isystem change in toolchain.
maria: @alex did you change any WORKSPACE entries? those can affect include roots.
alex: only bumped absl to 2025.02 and removed a legacy alias in //third_party/absl:absl_headers
jamal: can someone try `bazel build //tools/cc:config --config=linux-clang --sandbox_debug` to reproduce on CI-like env?
devon: running that now, will post logs
devon: ran locally with sandbox_debug, reproduced. `-Ithird_party/absl` missing from copts on that target.
alex: ok I'll roll a revert of the alias and open a follow-up to adjust BUILD files. can someone rerun the shard once I push?
ci-bot: [CI] retrigger request queued by devon - http://ci.internal/retry/9f3b2a7
jamal: if repro is trivial, please include `bazel query 'deps(//tools/cc:config)'` output in the PR, helps us catch transitive includes.
alex: will do. pushing revert now (PR #4130). thanks for quick triage :thumbsup:
devon: will watch the rerun, assign to eng-oncall if it persists
maria: FYI I filed a follow-up task to audit include aliases across third_party (T#824)
devon: rerun started, link: http://ci.internal/builds/9f3b2a7/retry/1
ci-bot: [CI] shard bazel-linux-shard-12 passed for commit a1b2c3d (revert PR #4130) - all green :tada:
alex: phew, thanks everyone.
